text:
maria: Heads-up — hitting steady mem growth (~2.3GB) over long contexts when paged-attention + KV cache are enabled on H100 DGX. Dedicated pool OOM at ~12k tokens :scream:. Repro script attached.
kevin: link to repro? can you paste the lightweight perf trace / top-line numbers?
maria: paste logs below (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-16T10:12:01Z] kvcache: page_alloc stripe=7 idx=98304 size=64KiB
[2026-03-16T10:12:02Z] kvcache: evict miss -> new_pt_entry=0x7f8aab.. refcount=2
[2026-03-16T10:12:05Z] runtime: mem_used=18.9GB mem_peak=21.2GB tokens=8200
kvcache: mapped_entries=1,024,000 reuse_ratio=0.03 evict_retries=4
```
Latency baseline ~130ms per request -> spikes to ~300ms around 10k tokens, and memory climbs steadily until OOM.
tara: reuse_ratio that low is suspicious. are evicted pages being freed/unlinked from pagetable? could be double-refs.
sajal: can you capture the small kernel trace around page transfer and pt_update? i suspect ordering on NVLink causing remote stale reads.
maria: dumped traces. relevant bits:
```
kv_transfer: gpu0 -> gpu1 start t=0.002s
pager: write_shadowmap(gpu1, idx=98304) t=0.003s (no fence)
consumer on gpu1 reads pt idx=98304 at t=0.0035s -> gets old mapping
later free path sees pt_ref-- but sometimes misses because shadowmap overlap
```
kevin: interesting — we don't see this on PCIe machines in prod. only NVLink/HM-enabled clusters (DGX/A100-NVLINK and H100 NVLINK). Might be a ordering/invalidation hole.
tara: could also be allocator alignment mismatch. I once saw page stripes get misaligned between pager and allocator, causing overlap and double-counting of the same physical page.
maria: bingo — found a case where allocator uses 128KiB alignment for large slabs on some kernels, but pager assumes 64KiB page granularity. result: two logical page indices map to the same physical stripe and we count both. repro shows pt indices with idx % 128 != 0 in the logs.
kevin: does kvcache expose a debug counter for reclaims / outstanding_refs? what does it show?
maria: enable debug: kvcache_page_reclaims=1200, outstanding_pages=4,321, reclamation_faults=0. But manually walking the PT shows entries with stale_owner!=0 and refcount>1.
sajal: sketch of root cause hypothesis: (1) pager migrates page to remote GPU; (2) writes new shadowmap entry but does not issue a cross-device completion/fence; (3) consumer on remote GPU can read pt entry before the owner refcount has been decremented on the origin; (4) if allocator alignment mismatch occurs, two logical indices point to overlapping region so free path decrements wrong counters -> leak.
infra-bot: nightly-ci job #kvcache-shadowmap-run created (2523456795) :robot_face:
maria: quick workaround pushed to prod: insert vm_barrier() (synchronous D2D invalidate) on transfer path and canonicalize page_index floor(addr / page_size) at every access. Perf hit roughly +3-6% end-to-end in p95 latency but stops growth and prevents OOM.
tara: we should add a unit test that simulates cross-GPU pagemigrations + mismatched alignments. also add a sanitizer that asserts pt indices are canonicalized before counting.
kevin: PR number? can we cherry-pick as hotfix to dedicated pool? this looks release-blocker for teams using very long contexts.
maria: opened PR #4621, label=release-blocker. Patch summary: canonicalize indices, add atomic dec on transfer-complete path, and insert nvlink completion before enabling consumer access. small test matrix: passes on PCIe, passes on H100-NVLINK in local CI, but we need soak.
sajal: one more note — on MI250 we saw slightly different symptom: no crash but progressive fragmentation + slowdowns (not full OOM). suspect ROCm page-stripe rounding differs. added targeted test on MI250 CI.
kevin: timeline? must get minimal fix staged behind a config flag so Dedicated can toggle quickly.
maria: plan: push hotfix flag gated (kv_pager.strict_barrier=true) -> roll to dedicated quick canary tomorrow on non-prod cluster. if green, rollout standard. tagging folks in #eng-releases.
kevin: sounds good. can you attach the repro script command here for oncall to run? add expected metrics to look for.
maria: repro command: `./tools/repro_kv_pager.sh --model gpt2 --gpu h100 --tokens 12000 --paged-attn --nvlink`
Expected: mem growth should plateau (delta < 200MB) after 2k tokens, reuse_ratio > 0.3, no pt entries with overlapping indices. p95 latency should not exceed baseline * 1.2.
tara: thanks. I'll add the unit + integration tests and a quick flame graph in the PR. :thumbsup:
kevin: great work catching this, @maria. once we have a canary signal we'll decide whether to ship to prod dedicated immediately. :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy queued for kvcache/hotfix-4621 to staging at 2026-03-16T18:00:00Z :package:
maria: dropping the perf flame and a short walkthrough in the PR description. will follow up with soak results later today.
